arguments.command:
cd /workspace/mytests && timeout 300 python3 - <<'EOF'
from harness import *
import json
H=[{"Type":"headers","End_Stream":True,"data_to_transfered":[[":method","GET"]]}]
C=[case('a',H)]
EV=[{"at":1,"kind":"headers","stream":0,"fields":[[":status","200"]],"end":True}]
# empty parts list
o = chk('no parts', doc(cases=C, events=EV, channels=[{"name":"c","parts":[]}]), expect_error=False)
print('   ', o['channels'][0])
# all zero-length parts
o = chk('zero-length parts', doc(cases=C, events=EV, channels=[ch('c',(None,''),('a',''),('a',''))]), expect_error=False)
print('   ', o['channels'][0])
# request split across zero-length parts in the middle
req = "GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nHost: h.example\r\nContent-Length: 0\r\n\r\n"
o = chk('zero parts inside', doc(cases=[case('a',H,host='h.example')], events=EV,
      channels=[ch('c',('a',req[:10]),(None,''),('a',req[10:]))]), expect_error=False)
r=o['channels'][0]['requests'][0]; print('   ', r['owner'], r['owners'], r['flags'], o['channels'][0]['committed'])
# case with zero frames + event at 0
o = chk('zero frames', doc(cases=[case('a',[])], events=[{"at":0,"kind":"data","stream":0,"data":"x","end":True}]), expect_error=False)
print('   ', [(c['state'],c['at'],c['frames'],c['response_frames'],c['flags']) for c in o['cases']])
# close at time 0 with sleeping case
o = chk('close at 0 sleeping', doc(cases=[case('a',[{"Type":"sleep","Time_to_Stop":0}])], events=[{"at":0,"kind":"close"}]), expect_error=False)
print('   ', [(c['state'],c['at']) for c in o['cases']])
# empty data event
o = chk('empty data event', doc(cases=C, events=[{"at":1,"kind":"data","stream":0,"data":"","end":True}]), expect_error=False)
print('   ', [(c['state'],c['response_frames'],c['response_body'],c['received']['n']) for c in o['cases']])
# trailing bytes after a complete request
o = chk('trailing junk', doc(cases=C, events=EV, channels=[ch('c',('a',req),('a','GET /'))]), expect_error=False)
print('   ', o['channels'][0]['error'], o['channels'][0]['committed'], len(o['channels'][0]['requests']))
# request with CR CR LF
o = chk('crcrlf', doc(cases=C, events=EV, channels=[ch('c',('a',"GET / HTTP/1.1\r\r\n\r\n"))]), expect_error=False)
print('   ', o['channels'][0]['error'])
EOF
